about_the_game:
Daily Driven Racer Demo puts you behind the wheel of five everyday cars in a fast, accessible racing experience across three unique tracks. Race solo against AI opponents or challenge a friend in local split-screen multiplayer.

Built on a well-balanced Simcade driving model, the demo blends realistic handling with the fun and ease of arcade-style racing—making it approachable for newcomers while offering depth for experienced players.

Demo Features:

  • 5 drivable cars based on everyday vehicles

  • 3 handcrafted tracks with distinct environments

  • Single-player races vs AI

  • 2-player local split-screen multiplayer

  • Simcade physics for an authentic yet accessible feel

Upgrade to the full version to unlock additional content, including more cars, tracks, game modes, and expanded 4-player split-screen multiplayer.
